goal: Grow ERN Search/Explore breadth without weakening Watch Earth truth.

watchEarth.rule: Continuous/current playback must satisfy the canonical currentness and playback gates. Search-only evidence never upgrades Watch Earth eligibility.

searchableQuasiLive.rule: Official/provider-published webcams, refreshed still cameras and current-image pages may be searchable when provider identity, place identity and freshness evidence are explicit. They must carry featuredHold/watchHold unless separately live-verified.

recentPicturesResearch.publicPromotionRule: A one-off recent provider photo is not automatically LIVE_IMAGE. Research it, but do not publish it as quasi-live unless it belongs to a regularly refreshed/timestamped current-image surface or ERN adds a separate RECENT_IMAGE visitor label.

safeguards: Never call a static/recent picture LIVE.
Never use business value to determine source truth or ranking.
Group multiple camera angles of one real place under one placeId.
Prefer official tourism, government, scientific, resort or direct-provider sources.
Link-only by default unless embed/reuse permission is explicit.
Pamir remains deferred until a genuinely useful live/quasi-live source appears.
